last_movies.title: 恶作剧：绑架雪莉·帕皮尼

introduction: David Allan Pearson (DAP), a graduate of the BFA program at the University of Alberta is a Canadian screen actor and acting teacher and coach based in Vancouver BC, Canada. DAP has worked repeatedly with Eric McCormack (Drinkwater 2021 & Travelers Netflix), & Grant Gustin (Rescued by Ruby 2022 & The Flash CW), as well as with Elijah Wood (Dirk Gently) and WWE Superstar The Big Show (Vendetta 2015)DAP stars alongside Elizabeth Gilles, Dietrich Bader, and Harvey Keitel in 2024's Spread premiering on Tubi July 18th at midnight.
